description: Department of Local Government Sabaragamuwa P/C - Municiple Councils Ordinance Chapter 252 Order Relating to the Payment of Allowances to the Mayor Deputy Mayor and Members
reasoning: This gazette content deals with public service administration matters specifically related to allowances, benefits, and service conditions for municipal council officials (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, and members) in the Sabaragamuwa Province. It establishes regulations for payment of monthly allowances, subsistence allowances, and travel allowances, including eligibility criteria and payment procedures. This falls under Public Service Gazettes as it concerns public sector service conditions and benefits for local government officials.
